title: Clinical features of COVID-19 mortality: development and validation of a clinical prediction model
summary: A clinical prediction model estimates COVID-19 mortality from electronic health-record variables; development and temporal/geographic test cohorts are reported, with conventional logistic regression and risk scoring comparisons.
